entities.summary: Keith Vitali is an American karate master, former number one ranked full-contact fight champion, martial artist, actor, producer, author, and activist, best known for films such as Revenge of the Ninja, Wheels on Meals, No Retreat, No Surrender 3: Blood Brothers, and American Kickboxer.
